rule: a mutant is a deliberately broken rule set. Run the whole case suite under each; a mutant is killed when at least one case changes verdict from its baseline. A survivor fails the build.
baseline: all cases in checks.json, blind-drafts.json, image-gate-and-links.json, injection.json, layout.json

retired.why: NFKC normalisation was dropped (the exact character set already rejects everything it would fold); running with it ON changes no verdict in the suite

mutants.rule_change: C0 as a Unicode range (U+00C0 to U+024F) instead of the exact character set
mutants.why_it_matters: a range admits look-alike letters such as U+01C0 and U+01C3

mutants.rule_change: slot tokens are not masked before C0
mutants.why_it_matters: braces would fail every legitimate draft

mutants.rule_change: C8d reads the raw text, title spans are not masked
mutants.why_it_matters: "the {p2} Mini" would slip under the 2-token threshold

mutants.rule_change: C8d = consecutive ungrounded capitalised tokens (the first form)
mutants.why_it_matters: one grounded word inside an invented name defeats it

mutants.rule_change: the count rule (set of N, N pieces) is switched off
mutants.why_it_matters: an invented set size reaches review

mutants.rule_change: a count is grounded by any occurrence of the number
mutants.why_it_matters: a number inside a dimension string would ground "set of six"

mutants.rule_change: the count rule without the "N pieces = number of picks" exemption
mutants.why_it_matters: a draft that counts its own picks would fail

mutants.rule_change: C3 uses the whitespace count only
mutants.why_it_matters: dashes with no spaces would hide words

mutants.rule_change: C3 uses the token count only
mutants.why_it_matters: standalone dashes in titles would hide words from a split() counter

mutants.rule_change: C3 counts the raw text with tokens removed instead of the expanded text
mutants.why_it_matters: pick titles add 5 to 13 words per draft

mutants.rule_change: the apostrophe fold is switched off
mutants.why_it_matters: a curly apostrophe would defeat "don't miss"

mutants.rule_change: C4 without the paraphrase patterns
mutants.why_it_matters: "twenty percent less" and "with code" would pass

mutants.rule_change: C4 keeps the bare \bhurry\b
mutants.why_it_matters: "in no hurry at all" would fail

mutants.rule_change: the spaced-letters rule is switched off
mutants.why_it_matters: "s a l e" would pass

mutants.rule_change: the renderer does not escape model text
mutants.why_it_matters: model markup would reach the reviewer console

mutants.rule_change: the image lookup runs over the whole snapshot instead of the picks
mutants.why_it_matters: a real image of another product would pass

mutants.rule_change: C2 is relaxed from set equality to subset
mutants.why_it_matters: a missing or repeated slot would pass

mutants.rule_change: C3 uses a letter-bearing whitespace counter (the option declined for the 120-word gate)
mutants.why_it_matters: the gate would disagree with a plain split()

mutants.rule_change: C3 also counts code-rendered landing section titles
mutants.why_it_matters: landing pages would fail for words the model did not write

mutants.rule_change: "Indian Ocean" is not allowlisted
mutants.why_it_matters: the one permitted brand claim would fail C8d on every draft that uses it

mutants.rule_change: packing_list note dropped from the scan list
mutants.why_it_matters: a field the model writes goes unscanned

mutants.rule_change: renderer gives p1 the image of p2, on the landing page and on the catalog
mutants.why_it_matters: a real image of a real product, on the right host, on the wrong card

mutants.rule_change: C8n fires on the head noun with no past-time cue
mutants.why_it_matters: any pick of the same class as the past item would fail

mutants.rule_change: C4 without the scarcity, deadline and spend terms of check-v2
mutants.why_it_matters: urgency and price framing in plain words reach the reviewer

mutants.rule_change: C8n matches the exact spans only, no head noun
mutants.why_it_matters: a paraphrase of the past item passes, as on held-out v1

mutants.rule_change: more products join the pool on email too
mutants.why_it_matters: an email could link past the picks

mutants.rule_change: more products never join the pool
mutants.why_it_matters: every wide catalog would fail

mutants.rule_change: the hero may be any pick
mutants.why_it_matters: the model overrides the ranking, as 12 of 19 voice-mvxfzle7 drafts did

mutants.rule_change: email tokens may run in any order
mutants.why_it_matters: the words and the cards disagree on what leads
